info.name: Marks API
info.description:
Student Marks Management API assignment collection.

Prerequisites: run the Development API at https://localhost:7134, apply the EF Core migrations, and seed the documented development accounts and data. Select the Local environment and run the entire collection once in its saved order.

Teacher requests inherit the collection's Bearer {{token}} authentication. Login and health requests use No Auth. Student permission checks explicitly use {{studentToken}}. Login scripts populate both environment tokens automatically.

Student, course and enrollment create requests generate temporary fixtures and save their IDs in collection variables. CRUD and enrollment cleanup requests delete those fixtures before the final Negative Tests folder. Seed records are retained; report assertions use the documented seed marks and Grading:PassMark=50.

Before committing or sharing an environment export, clear token and studentToken. Do not change the folder order or omit setup/cleanup requests when running the whole collection.

A successful GET response will have a `200 OK` status, and should include some kind of response body - for example, HTML web content or JSON data.
